text:
Asha: Scheduling airgap packaging push tonight 00:30 UTC for private-vpc customers. Target tag: private-installer:2.11.0-rc2. Includes shrinkwrap delta + manifest rotation. Need packaging + operations ack.
Ben: Ack. Building shrinkwrap now. Will produce both full bundle and delta for customers on older 2.10.x lanes.
Liam: Canary plan? recommend 4 seeds across regions and 2 mirror audits. Keep the customer mirror rollout throttled.
Asha: Canary seeds: pvstg-1..4. Mirror audits: mirror-int-1 (integrations), mirror-cust-1 (customer smoke). 20m observation.
deploybot: packaging job #2781 started; artifacts: bundle-2.11.0-rc2.tar.gz, delta-2.10-to-2.11.0-rc2.patch, manifest-v2.11.0.json.
Ben: Note: manifest schema bumped to include manifest.signer_version. Old deploy agent needs a soft-fallback; ops will coordinate agent-side compatibility.
Liam: Rollback conditions: immediate rollback if installer exits non-zero during postinstall on >1 seed OR cosign verification fails on any mirror. Non-critical unpack warnings tolerated.
Asha: Runbook summary: 1) stop promotion: `deployctl stop-promotion --env=private`. 2) rollback pin: `releasectl pin --env=private --image=private-installer:2.10.5`. 3) if signer mismatch, run key-sync and re-sign then retry.
deploybot: canary started @00:31:05 UTC on [pvstg-1,pvstg-2,pvstg-3,pvstg-4].
Ben: pvstg-1: delta applied OK, service healthy. logs: "postinstall: success, svc listening on 8443"
Ben: pvstg-2: failed with 'manifest parse error: unknown field signer_version' — agent needs compat flag.
Asha: Hold. Do not proceed to mirrors until pvstg-2 fixed. That fits the manifest bump note.
Liam: Quick mitigation: push a compatibility shim to the agent on pvstg-2, or fallback to full bundle instead of delta. Which is faster?
Ben: Full bundle restore will likely be faster for this single seed. I'll push full bundle to pvstg-2 and retry.
deploybot: pvstg-2 full bundle applied @00:43:12 UTC. Status: OK. Canary now 4/4 green @00:46:00 UTC.
Liam: Telemetry: CPU and unpack time slightly higher for full bundle on pvstg-2 but within SLO. Proceed to mirror-int-1 for smoke.
Asha: Reminder: cosign sig must be present on manifest. If cosign missing, block promotion to customer mirror.
deploybot: mirror-int-1 applied delta and manifest verification passed. cosign sig present.
Ben: Uploading signed manifest to mirror s3://private-releases/2.11.0-rc2/manifest.json.sig
Asha: Start limited customer mirror to mirror-cust-1 with throttling (10% of fleet). Watch for install exit codes.
deploybot: mirror-cust-1 applying at 01:05:24 UTC throttled to 10%.
Ben: mirror-cust-1: 2% failures reported (network timeout) — retrying.
Liam: Policy: if failures <=5% and transient (timeouts) within 10m, we rollforward (retry). If failures >5% or non-transient errors (installer non-zero exit), perform full rollback.
Asha: Agreed. Monitor for 10m and escalate to @oncall for anything beyond.
oncall: I'll standby; notify if >5% or cosign issues.
deploybot: mirror-cust-1 retries completed; failures resolved. Promotion paused for throttling control.
Ben: Tagging release branch and creating release notes PR: "2.11.0-rc2: shrinkwrap + manifest schema bump. Note: agent compat required for signer_version; rollforward allowed for <=5% transient failures."
Asha: Post-deploy action: add agent compatibility note to ops runbook + schedule small agent patch rollout next week to support manifest.signer_version.
Liam: Good catch. Also confirm cosign TTL — Ben?
Ben: cosign TTL checked; signer cert valid until 2026-09-12.
Asha: Closing loop: change window ends 02:00 UTC. If anything actionable after window, schedule emergency window or coordinate with account teams. Thanks team.
